content_fixes.old: When you go to war and God gives you the W, you'll probably take prisoners. If you see a beautiful woman among them and you're feeling her and want to marry her, here's the deal: you take her home, she shaves her head, cuts her nails, and gets rid of the clothes she was captured in. She then gets a full month to mourn her parents. After that, you can sleep with her and be married. But, if you're not vibing with her later on, you have to let her go free. You can't sell her or treat her like a slave, since you already humiliated her by taking her captive.
content_fixes.new: When you go to war and God hands your enemies over to you, you'll probably take prisoners. If you see a beautiful woman among them and you're drawn to her and want to marry her, here's the deal: you take her home, she shaves her head, cuts her nails, and gets rid of the clothes she was captured in. She then gets a full month to mourn her parents. After that, you can sleep with her and be married. But if you're no longer drawn to her later on, you have to let her go free. You can't sell her or treat her like a slave, since you already humiliated her by taking her captive.
content_fixes.reason: 'God gives you the W', 'you're feeling her', 'not vibing with her' trivialize a law about a captive woman; MSG v10-11 'When you go to war against your enemies and God hands them over to you... you see a beautiful woman among the captives and are attracted to her'.

content_fixes.old: But what if the brother is like, 'Nah, I'm not into it, I don't want to marry her'? In that case, the widow goes to the city leaders at the gate and says, 'My brother-in-law is refusing to keep his brother's name alive in Israel; he won't do his duty.' Then the leaders will summon the brother and talk to him. If he's stubborn and says, 'I don't want her,' then his sister-in-law is supposed to walk up to him, pull his sandal right off his foot, spit in his face, and declare, 'This is what happens to the man who refuses to build up his brother's family!' From then on, his family will be known in Israel as 'The Family with No Sandal.' Lowkey savage.
